title.narrative: Community-led conservation of Asian elephants in Myinmoletkhat Key Biodiversity Area, Myanmar

description.narrative: This project will contribute to the conservation of wild Asian elephants through the establishment of community conserved areas in Myinmoletkhat Key Biodiversity Area (KBA), Myanmar. Project objectives include: 1) building the capacity of the Conservation Alliance Tanintharyi (CAT) to collect baseline information on elephants, habitats and threats for long-term conservation; and 2) establishing a local community elephant surveillance system to support existing Forest Department (FD) and Karen National Union (KNU) law enforcement systems to reduce threats to elephants and their habitat. Specific project activities will include: 1) train CAT to assess the distribution and seasonal movements of elephants, document the status of elephant habitats, and the distribution of the main threats they face; 2) support CAT to conduct key informant interviews and field surveys to assess the distribution and seasonal movements of elephants, habitat quality and threats; 3) collate, analyze data and present to the local communities for future action; 4) establish a local elephant surveillance system by recruiting local wildlife guardians to support existing FD and KNU law enforcement system to reduce to elephants and their habitat; and 5) inform national policies on protected areas to enable community based conservation using Myinmoletkhat KBA as a model.
